text:
Eli: evening passoff — I'm primary for tonight until 03:00 PT. Quick credential/roles checklist before I step away:

Eli: 1) PagerDuty mobile push & escalation: confirm you can ack/resolve and trigger a test incident in the 'infra' schedule
Eli: 2) AWS assume-role: confirm you can assume `redwood-oncall` and run a quick EC2 describe
Eli: 3) Grafana access: confirm dashboards load and that you can open the incident dashboard and alerting rule links
Eli: 4) Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.com/infra/oncall-passoff — read 'bridge start' and 'role swap' sections

jess: I'm secondary, here till 06:30 PT. I'll run the PD test now.
incident-bot: [notification] Test incident created by jess — ID #test-3765
jess: Acked the test, got push notif, escalations look normal :thumbsup: 

sre-jin: I'll check AWS. Using SSO; to validate assume-role:

sre-jin: ```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall --role-session-name oncall-test
# then export creds and run: aws ec2 describe-instances --region us-west-2
```

sre-jin: succeeded, can query EC2 and list S3 buckets. no stale keys.
ops-amy: Grafana note — some cached panels sometimes 403 for new users, if you hit 403 refresh and try the 'incidents' folder link. Short link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/Incidents
ops-amy: also confirm you can mute/unmute alert rules (needs team 'oncall' graf role)

sam: small coverage note — APAC overnight gap between 00:00-01:30 PT. If we get paged for latency on asia-region pods, escalate to infra-oncall and notify account team.
Eli: noted — sam to be first pager for APAC if page arrives during that window; jess becomes backup. I'll add an alias in PD.

Eli: final check: creds canary — run the assume-role command above and then hit the alert mute endpoint:

Eli: ```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN' https://api.redwood.com/v1/alerts/mute --data '{"alert_id":"test-canary"}'
```

jess: token worked locally. muted test alert.

Eli: leaving bridge open. Runbooks pinned in channel. If incident-bot posts active incidents, ping me and sre-jin. Good to go? :white_check_mark:

jess: all good from me. :white_check_mark:
sre-jin: verified. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: [log] passoff checklist completed by Eli, jess, sre-jin, ops-amy, sam
